findings.description: LocalH3VideoProviderFamily.get_local_status() and fetch_local() bind a reopened submission to the request using resolved_generation_hash, but do not also compare LocalVideoSubmission.generation_id. A separately sealed submission can therefore retain the request hash while carrying a different generation_id/provider request identity and still reach the child adapter.
findings.recommendation: Fail closed on both generation_id and resolved_generation_hash in status and fetch, and add a forged-but-valid submission regression test. The normal VideoGenerationService reconstruction reduces exposure but does not replace the public family boundary check.
